hotspots.title: Nigel Farage resignation triggers by-election storm
hotspots.blurb: Nigel Farage resigns as MP for Clacton to trigger a by-election he will contest, framing it as a 'people vs establishment' battle amid multiple financial controversies. The move follows scrutiny over £5M in undeclared donations and ties to convicted fraudster George Cottrell.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Farage's polarizing persona, the high-stakes by-election framing, and the moral panic over financial impropriety in right-wing politics.
